conditions.model: open arrivals; bounded generator concurrency; no automatic retries
conditions.cache: 8 insertion-order entries; warm-up3; retained between scenarios within each repetition

machine.runtimeDependencies: Node built-ins; node:sqlite is experimental in this runtime

processRssBytes.meaning: Combined server+generator process maximum RSS observations; not isolated term coefficients

limitations: Loopback experiment, single process SQLite sync connection and co-resident generator; no production or multi-replica capacity inference.
All generated response latency samples include rejections, dependency failures and client timeouts. Dropped demand has no response latency and is separately counted.
Generator creates fresh TLS connections (agent:false); TLS CPU and local runtime are part of measurements. No automatic retries.
SQLite query rows examined, physical I/O, lock wait, OS FD/NAT exhaustion and cold filesystem cache are UNVERIFIED.
No optimization speedup claim; these are bounded workload observations only.
